## Patterns and Algebra {#vol-02 .section-title}

```{=html}
<section class="wh-hero geo-mountains">
  <div class="wh-hero__body">
    <div class="wh-hero__left">
      <p>You already know how numbers behave. This volume is about what happens when one of the numbers is missing — and about the notation that lets you work with that absence as if it were a thing you could hold.</p>
      <p>By the end you will be able to write a relationship down symbolically, solve for unknowns, recognise when a relationship is linear versus something else, and read a graph as a statement about how two quantities relate. These are the tools every quantitative field uses before it reaches for anything more sophisticated.</p>

          <div class="wh-hero-card__dek">When a number is unknown, algebra gives it a name and a set of rules for finding it. That shift from arithmetic to algebra is this volume's core contribution.</div>
```

```{=html}
<div class="wh-book-grid wh-reveal">

  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
```
